fields.Name: IT111 - Agent Pre-Execution RAG Permission Gate
fields.Description: Pre-execution RAG's scope-permission gate, deterministic, no LLM: the checks call AgentPreExecutionRAG.Execute() directly for the seeded IT: Search Agent. The bundle seeds no notes (a note save embeds); the proof is the search log.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A granted run of pre-execution RAG leaves a Success search-log row for the IT scope and no Forbidden row; an agent with SearchScopeAccess='None' gets null and exactly one Forbidden row attributed to it.
